body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It starts at Rotterdam (Erasmusbrug).

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Hop on the Waterbus in Rotterdam, and visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk.
>
> Traveling by Waterbus is easy and quick. You can sit inside or on the open-air deck, enjoying views of Rotterdam’s skyline. At Kinderdijk, see the iconic windmills and learn about Dutch history.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.94. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 59 ratings and 28 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
